pilotMethod.scope: Known generated pilot in hold interiors; neither exclusive process attribution nor provider source continuity is inferred.

providerBoundaryProbeLimit: At most 1024 body bytes read per GET; full bodies are not validated. Intentional early close may increment relay transfer failures.
sourceHashPolicy: Build-input working file SHA256, including checkout line endings; Python analysis hashes describe the final offline analyzer.
collectionVersionNote: The collector observe arithmetic is identical in both rate runs; finite-configuration checks and offline analysis were added after the first launch. Both runs use the same worker JAR.
